synthesis:draft.headline: What was known at 07:00 about TAS1 demand forecasts on 2026-08-06?
summary: Public POE50 forecasts for TAS1 covering 2026-08-05T21:00:00Z→2026-08-06T09:00:00Z were available as of 2026-08-05T21:00:00Z; selected POE50 values provably public by that as-of: 1084.0 MW for 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z [ev0538].
An earlier public run gave POE50 = 1160.0 MW for 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z [ev0034].

Other provably-public POE50 values in the target window (selected): 1085.0 MW for 2026-08-06T03:30:00Z [ev0541], 1275.0 MW for 2026-08-06T07:00:00Z [ev0562], 1335.0 MW for 2026-08-06T07:30:00Z [ev0565], and 1417.0 MW for 2026-08-06T09:00:00Z [ev0574].

Measured (initial) operational demand was only available up to 2026-08-05T18:00:00Z in the returned series; the maximum reported value in that available series was 1053.0 MW at 2026-08-05T18:00:00Z [ev0582].
AEMO procedure text states: "The Demand Forecasting System or DFS generates the 10%, 50% and 90% POE demand forecasts to be used in pre-dispatch and STPASA processes." [c1].

numeric_claims.text: Maximum available measured operational demand in returned series = 1053.0 MW at 2026-08-05T18:00:00Z

possible_explanations.statement: The different POE50 values for 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z (1160.0 MW [ev0034] vs 1084.0 MW [ev0538]) might reflect that a later forecast run was published after the earlier run and replaced or supplemented it.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare the two run entries' issued_at_utc / published_at_utc / available_at_utc timestamps and the run_id sequences returned by the forecast tool to confirm which run was published later and whether values changed between runs.

possible_explanations.statement: The comparison of forecasts to actuals could not be produced at the 07:00 as-of because initial measured operational-demand values for the forecast target intervals were not yet provably public as of 2026-08-05T21:00:00Z; the available measured series only covered intervals up to 2026-08-05T18:00:00Z (maximum 1053.0 MW) [ev0582].
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Re-run the aligned forecast-vs-actual comparison with an as_of after the target intervals' initial measured operational-demand values became public; if initial actuals for the targets are then present the comparison will produce forecast error statistics.

uncertainties: Forecast-vs-actual errors for the target window could not be computed at the 2026-08-05T21:00:00Z as-of because the required initial actuals for the forecast target intervals were not provably public by that time.

Which specific public run should be treated as the authoritative forecast for each interval (when multiple public runs exist for the same interval) is unclear from the returned value-level evidence alone; run-level timestamps/ids are needed to disambiguate.
missing_evidence: Initial measured (operational) demand values for the forecast target intervals 2026-08-05T21:30:00Z through 2026-08-06T07:00:00Z provably public by 2026-08-05T21:00:00Z (these were not present in the returned actuals).
